name: HU3
author: 4dean
description: Go under the cube portal as the reverse gravity ship at 35.7% and then fall up into the levels gameplay. Navigate through the following gameplay as the ship while avoiding all gamemode portals until 54% where you have to fly up a bit to enter the next section, touch only the pink dash orb at 56% and then fall above the level between the spike and slope shortly after. Stay above the gameplay until the end from there.
